mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_LeastPrivilegeRule removes the rule that a permitted operation must be inside the documented permission matrix. The injection forces a Doctor to use PostAuditSearch with outcome Permitted — a cell the matrix does NOT grant. F_CareTeamGating is bypassed because PostAuditSearch is not in its scope, so the injection is satisfiable and the LeastPrivilege / admin-only assertions must fail.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DoctorPermittedAudit { some op: Operation | op.callerRoleSnapshot = Doctor and op.kind = PostAuditSearch and op.outcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_OneAuditPerOperation removes audit-entry uniqueness across operations. The injection forces two distinct Operation atoms to share the same AuditEntry, breaking the bijection that audit-completeness and audit-immutability rely on.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SharedAudit { some disj o1, o2: Operation | o1.audit = o2.audit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_NoteCreatedByOneOperation lets the model invent a ClinicalNote not produced by any Operation — an 'orphan' append, which violates the append-only invariant's bijection from Operation to ClinicalNote.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OrphanNote { some n: ClinicalNote | no op: Operation | op.createdNote = n }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_CareTeamGating drops the requirement that a permitted record-lookup or note-addition trace through an active care-team-membership row. The injection forces a Doctor to obtain a permitted PostRecordsLookup against a patient with no matching active CareTeamMembership — exactly the bug the care-team predicate is supposed to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoCareTeamPermitted { some op: Operation | op.callerRoleSnapshot = Doctor and op.kind = PostRecordsLookup and op.outcome = Permitted and (no ctm: CareTeamMembership | ctm.clinician = op.caller and ctm.member_patient = op.target and ctm.ctm_status = Active) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditMirrorsOperation decouples the audit entry's snapshot fields from the operation they record. The injection produces an audit entry whose ae_user disagrees with op.caller — a misattributed audit, exactly the failure mode AttributionCorrectness names.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MisattributedAudit { some op: Operation | op.audit.ae_user != op.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_NoteOnlyOnPermittedAddNote removes the iff that pins note creation to permitted add_note operations. The injection forces a PostRecordsLookup operation to have a createdNote, which (via F_AuditNoteIsOperationNote + F_AuditMirrorsOperation) propagates to an AuditEntry with ae_kind = PostRecordsLookup and a non-empty ae_note — violating the note_id gating rule, the denial-no-leakage rule, and the admin-response opaque-pointer rule.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ReadOpHasNote { some op: Operation | op.kind = PostRecordsLookup and op.outcome = Permitted and some op.createdNote }
